spans.s:
पि-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered or hidden;
to be stopped up, to be shut or closed.

पि-धान, अम्, n. covering, stopping up, shut-
ting; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a covering, cover,
concealment; a lid, top, cover; a sheath; a wrap-
per, cloak; [cf. Cambro-Brit. fedon, ‘a screen.’]
[]
—पिधान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, provided with a cover,
covered with a lid.

पिधानक, अस्, m. a cover, lid; a sheath, scab-
bard [cf. खड्ग-प्˚].

पि-धायक, अस्, इका, अम्, covering, hiding, con-
cealing.
—पिधायक-ता, f. the state or act of
covering.
